name: lagaam
description: Trino and Pinot MCP server that prices each query from EXPLAIN and refuses it before it runs if it's over budget or outside the tables you allow

allowed_tables.title: Allowed tables
allowed_tables.description: Comma list of catalog.schema.table names the agent may read, for example hive.sales.orders,hive.sales.customers (on Pinot, pinot.default.events). The server won't start without it

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Which engine Lagaam connects to: trino or pinot

trino_user.title: Trino user
trino_user.description: User Lagaam connects to Trino as

pinot_controller_url.title: Pinot controller URL
pinot_controller_url.description: Pinot controller URL, used when engine is pinot

pinot_broker_url.title: Pinot broker URL
pinot_broker_url.description: Pinot broker URL, used when engine is pinot
